description: This file is a Java class implementing the ApplicationInfoRepository interface and InitializingBean to load application info data from a database into an in-memory map. It uses Spring Framework annotations and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A Spring component class that loads application information from the database into an in-memory map upon startup.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the repository by loading application info data from the database into the in-memory map.

methods.name: getAppInfoMap
methods.description: Returns the map of application info objects keyed by their ID.
